brief: A base fitted with a hex-turbo-drawer-9000.

requirements.requirement: A base (hex base) in the build
requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full is on the build (the only part present, unchanged).

No part named hex-turbo-drawer-9000 exists in the catalog. find_parts for 'turbo drawer 9000' and for 'drawer' return only notch and bay drawer frames (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf/fm, -x2, and hex-drawer-frame-bay-n/s, -x2). find_sockets for drawer offers nothing on the current build. I did not substitute a part or invent a ref.

finish.summary: I did not build the requested drawer because no part called hex-turbo-drawer-9000 exists in this catalog. I left the build as it was: one full hex base. The closest real options are a notch drawer frame (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf or -fm, single or double height), which fills the empty position between two bases that touch each other, or a bay drawer frame (hex-drawer-frame-bay-n or -s), which needs three cells around an empty position. If you confirm which of these you want, or give the correct part name, I can add a second base beside the current one and fit that drawer.
